page_title: JUV 5-0 CRE | Juventus v Cremonese 12/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's it for today, Ermano Feliciani has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
89' Flag up against Jonathan David (Juventus). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cremonese comes to nothing.
87' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cremonese.
85' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
83' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Francesco Folino (Cremonese) replaces Alberto Grassi.
83' Fabio Miretti goes off the pitch and Lois Openda (Juventus) comes on.
82' Some neat passing and movement from Juventus as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
80' The corner from Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) is intercepted by the defence.
80' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jonathan David (Juventus) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
76' 3:4 – the corner kicks stats.
73' Cremonese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' The resulting set piece from Cremonese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Cremonese will take a corner.
73' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Cremonese can continue in their attacking effort.
71' Manuel Locatelli will be replaced by Vasilije Adzic (Juventus).
71' Substitution. Bremer makes way for Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus).
70' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) replacing Warren Bondo.
68' Ermano Feliciani shows a yellow card to Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) for his blatant foul.
65' A pass by Edon Zhegrova (Juventus) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

64' 5 - 0 It's a goal! Weston McKennie (Juventus) bravely launches himself at a cross from Pierre Kalulu and gives Emil Audero no chance with a close-range bullet header into the left of the goal. 5:0.
62' Here is a change. Kenan Yildiz is going off and Luciano Spalletti gives the last tactical orders to Edon Zhegrova (Juventus).
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Juan Cabal (Juventus) coming on for Andrea Cambiaso.
61' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) sends a cross into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
58' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Federico Bonazzoli and he is replaced by Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese).
58' Today's match ends for Jamie Vardy who will be replaced by Franco Vazquez (Cremonese).
58' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
56' The linesman signals that Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
54' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Emil Audero sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.

53' Weston McKennie (Juventus) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
50' Cremonese are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
49' Cremonese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

49' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Cremonese force their opponents to concede a corner.
48' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) deflects the ball past his own goalkeeper and into the goal after trying to jump in the way of a shot!
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Davide Nicola probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Dennis Johnsen. He is replaced by Romano Floriani (Cremonese).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' The resulting corner from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is cleared.

45+5' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. It will be a corner kick for Juventus.
45+4' Juventus hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
45+2' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
42' Weston McKennie (Juventus) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
41' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

40' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Emil Audero is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Juventus have a corner.
38' A spell of possession for Juventus in an attempt to control the game.
35' 3 - 0 Goal! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.
35' We have witnessed an unsuccessful penalty. Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) failed to convert his penalty kick.
35' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is going to take the penalty!
35' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to Juventus!
34' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Juventus using VAR. Let's see what happens.
33' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus are awarded a penalty kick!
32' Some patient build-up play from Cremonese as they look to unlock the defence.
29' 5:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
27' Referee Ermano Feliciani has finally had enough of Davide Nicola and gives him a straight RED CARD!
27' Davide Nicola is stunned as referee Ermano Feliciani shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
27' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Cremonese! Play can continue.
24' There's a break in play and referee Ermano Feliciani must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Cremonese using VAR. This could be interesting!
24' Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
23' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
23' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman makes the right call and Juventus will have a corner.
22' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
21' Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
17' Cremonese are seeing far more of the ball now.
15' 2 - 0 Goal! Khephren Thuram shows great vision to find Jonathan David (Juventus) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
14' Cremonese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

13' A snap shot from distance by Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cremonese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' 1 - 0 Bremer (Juventus) surprises all the fans with a long-range header that beats the goalkeeper. The ball ends up in the right side of the target and the score changes to 1:0.
11' The free kick into the penalty area from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is cleared.
11' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus win a free kick.
10' A pass from Fabio Miretti (Juventus) is intercepted by Emil Audero and the move breaks down.
9' Juventus hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Jonathan David (Juventus) takes a shot from inside the box and hits the right post!
6' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Emil Audero is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
2' Some great controlled play and passing from Juventus. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani will supervise the game today.
